hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$cmd" in *claude-skills-internal*) exit 0 ;; esac; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])main($|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Push may target main - user rule: NEVER push to main unless explicitly approved"}}'; elif printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push( +--?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9=-]*)*( +origin)? *($|[;&|])'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Bare git push - target branch unspecified, confirm it does not touch main"}}'; fi
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; npx prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
